messages:
Elaine: Heads-up — seeing a noticeable slowdown on axis label rendering in prod dashboards after the routing-policy change and the telemetry rollout. EU canary users report graphs taking ~1.2-2s longer to fully paint. frontend@v4.12.0 rolled ~10:30 UTC.

Sam: Is this tied to the telemetry proxy change we merged this morning? @perf-bot did you surface anything?

perf-bot: alert created -> metric: dashboard.chart_lcp.eu-prod > 1s (since 10:35). alert_id:#12345 :warning:

Ryan: Saw the trace. Main thread parse + eval spiked. Quick snippet from the trace:
```
MainThread.parseScript 420ms
evalScript 300ms
telemetry-sampler.js parse: 180ms
chunk telemetry-proxy.js size: ~1.1MB (uncompressed)
```
Also a lot of forced layout calls around axis label width calculations.

Elaine: I compared bundle diffs between v4.11.9 -> v4.12.0 — telemetry sampler + new telemetry-proxy client added ~200kb gz. The sampler now eager-inits and hits sync text metrics during render path.

Alexa: Can we toggle the rollout or flip a feature flag? If we can disable eager init while we investigate, that'd be ideal.

Sam: We can flip TELEMETRY_EAGER_INIT=false via the feature-config service for prod canary. Or pin route policy back (we changed route-priority earlier). Quick mitigation: disable eager init and revert the sampler change in a small patch.

Ryan: Quick local hack that reduces sync layout: use offscreen canvas for measureText or memoize label widths on first measure. Example patch idea:
```
const offscreen = new OffscreenCanvas(1,1).getContext('2d');
function measuredWidth(label, font) {
  offscreen.font = font;
  return offscreen.measureText(label).width;
}
```
This avoids touching DOM during paint.

perf-bot: note -> perf test failure bucket: chart-lcp-regressions. tag: telemetry-rollout

Elaine: I'll open a revert PR for the eager init in the sampler and a smaller follow-up to memoize measureText. I'll also attach the full flamegraph to the issue. @Alexa can you flip the feature flag on the canary and run a 10-min smoke?

Alexa: On it. Flipping TELEMETRY_EAGER_INIT=false for eu-prod canary now. Will report back in ~10m.

Sam: If the canary looks clean, we should coordinate a rollback window and then re-deploy with the safer axis renderer patch.

Ryan: Post-mortem action: add a CI perf check that runs headless traces on a couple of representative dashboards (heatmap, multi-series) to catch large parse/paint regressions before rollout.

Elaine: Agreed. Creating an issue for CI perf harness and tagging infra + devex. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
